S. a. l. note 400); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 277:1">Yalk. Ex. 277</cite>.—[
<cite ref="Yoma 78b">Yoma 78ᵇ</cite> <he>מאני פ׳ וכ׳</he> Ms. M. 1 gilded or glazed earthen vessels, v. <cite ref="C00538"><he>גְּזַז</he></cite>.]
